title: Machine learning screens perovskite oxygen-reduction electrodes
summary: The study introduced ionic Lewis-acid strength as a physical descriptor and used machine learning to screen 6,871 perovskite compositions. Four oxides were synthesized and reported to have superior oxygen-reduction activity metrics in specified ceramic-fuel-cell tests. The record counts one paper-level study and does not imply 6,871 physical syntheses or commercial deployment.
ai_technology: Machine-learning composition screening; ionic Lewis-acid-strength descriptor

evidence.tested: Primary publisher abstract reports four synthesized oxides screened from 6,871 and experimental activity results.
evidence.unknown: Exact formulation-level overlap and independent replication not exhaustively assessed.
evidence.ai_role: ML plus physical descriptor screened composition candidates followed by synthesis and electrochemical tests.

source_review.scope: Primary source checked for identity, date, model role and bounded reported result.
